comment: -T was 0.2, which put the pair PBCHM28130395 / PBCHM67649930 exactly on
the threshold, so whether it was kept depended on floating point
rounding. --config=native enables FMA, which drops an intermediate
rounding and put that distance a hair under 0.2, while a build without
it landed on or above. build_linux.sh defaults BUILD_NATIVE=1, so the
documented build failed this test while a non-native build passed.
0.21 has the same problem, on PBCHM67673781 / PBCHM100210717, as do
0.2 and 0.225. 0.205 was checked to give byte identical output from
both an --config=native and a plain -c opt build.
NOTE: out/Darwin/stdout still corresponds to -T 0.2 and needs to be
regenerated on a Mac. It cannot be derived from the Linux output - the
two differ in how small floats are formatted (0.0854 vs 8.54e-02).
test.name: case_1
